Q.6 In a recently held parent-teacher meeting, the teachers had very few complaints about Ravi. After all, Ravi was a hardworking and kind student. Incidentally, almost all of Ravi’s friends at school were hardworking and kind too. But the teachers drew attention to Ravi’s complete lack of interest in sports. Based only on the information provided above, which one of the following statements can be logically inferred with certainty? (A) All of Ravi’s friends are hardworking and kind.
